title: Icedrive: Secure Cloud Storage
summary: Secure cloud storage with photo backup, streaming and sharing
description:
Secure cloud storage for your photos, videos and files.

Icedrive is a fast, private cloud storage app that makes backing up, streaming and sharing your files simple. Upload your photos, videos and documents and access them instantly across all your devices.

Key features

• Secure cloud storage
Protect your files with strong encryption (available on premium plans). Your data stays private and under your control.

• Automatic photo backup
Back up your camera photos automatically so you never lose important memories.

• Stream without downloading
Play music, watch videos and preview documents directly from the cloud.

• Easy file sharing
Share files securely using links or send files directly to other Icedrive users.

• Access anywhere
Use Icedrive on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS or the web. One account, all your files.

Best of all?
You get 10GB of free cloud storage as soon as you sign up.
